learning_objective: 🎯 Blast off into space and discover how a tiny, unexpected pet can become a massive hero, teaching us that nature and technology must work together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Meet Claribel, a tiny canary living secretly on a high-tech space station. She easily learns to fly in zero gravity, bringing joy and a little piece of Earth to the busy astronauts.
When the expensive, high-tech alarms fail to detect a deadly drop in oxygen, little Claribel faints. The crew quickly realizes that something is terribly wrong with their air supply!
Thanks to the bird's high sensitivity to bad air, the crew fixes the oxygen leak just in time. The story proves that even in the most futuristic settings, nature's built-in alarms are priceless.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ My Space Pet
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are moving to a space station and can bring one small pet. Draw your pet in a spacesuit and write a sentence about how it helps the crew!

quick_recap: ⭐ Claribel the canary is smuggled onto a space station and happily adapts to weightlessness.
⭐ When high-tech air alarms completely fail, the tiny bird's fainting alerts the crew to a toxic gas leak.
⭐ A brilliant mix of science fiction showing that simple nature often outsmarts complex technology.
